protocol.trigger: Unique actually collected INITIAL tasks / fixed initial 60 tasks:20%,35%,50%,65%,80%. New tasks never change trigger denominator; each method has independent history.
protocol.event_policy: Fixed coordinates and shapes, cumulative persistent events; stop session if current/base becomes blocked or returned plan invalid; no relocating event, no alternate planner, no retry.
protocol.model: Original frozen versions; unit cardinal moves; cell-center collection; no any-angle or central collection zones.
protocol.history_contract: initial_targets supplied to each replan = publication before that event, not permanent session-initial denominator
protocol.preflight: All cumulative stages connected to base; geometry-only reachability checked before planner calls
protocol.comparison: Report completed and deferred sets; distance ranking only for identical physical completed/deferred sets; single small synthetic mixed world not general evidence
